The '''Shleepy Sheep Skin''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Pet Skin]] that can be purchased from the Hypixel Store.

== Obtaining ==
{{Cosmetic Miscellaneous Source|The '''Shleepy Sheep Skin''' can be purchased from the Hypixel Store in the 2026 Summer Legacy Bundle.|2026 Hypixel Store Summer Legacy Bundle}}

== Usage ==
{{Pet Skin Usage|applied = Sheep Pet|selectable_versions=16|notes = {{Green|This skin is swappable between 16 sleepy variants that change depending on the time of day!}}}}
